answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 7390 Country: United Kingdom Title: It has been said that by wearig certain stones it gives good luck to a person, is it permissible to wear a silver ring with a specific stone on it with the intention that because of the specific stone on the ring Allah will give good luck? 2-0r is it Shirk? please provide refrence. Question: Assalaamualaykum 1-It has been said that by wearig certain stones it gives good luck to a person, is it permissible to wear a silver ring with a specific stone on it with the intention that because of the specific stone on the ring Allah will give good luck? 2-0r is it Shirk? please provide refrence. Answer ID: 7390 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1457/1372=D/1429) If, by the experiment of the hakims and physicians, the effect of some stone is known then there is nothing wrong in wearing the same. Some things have some special effects, this is just like the herbs and medicines have effect. It is permissible to wear it for treatment of diseases. But, it is unlawful to wear them with the belief of good luck or considering it effective in itself. It is wrong to have belief of good luck about the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
